subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Nation-State Hackers
description: A short lesson to help you apply Nation-State Hackers.

hook.text: Some of the most sophisticated hackers don't work in basements. They work for governments.

buildup.text: Nation-state hackers target infrastructure, steal secrets, and disrupt rivals — all with government funding.

discovery.text: Russia's SolarWinds hack in 2020 compromised 18,000 organizations including US government agencies.

twist.text: Governments also stockpile vulnerabilities. The NSA's leaked tools became the WannaCry ransomware attack.

climax.text: Nation-states are the top tier of cyber threats. Private companies are often outgunned and outfunded.

quiz.question: What was notable about the SolarWinds hack?
options: It compromised 18,000 organizations including US agencies
It was carried out by a teenager
